title: On the maximal displacement of subcritical branching random walk in random environment
summary: In this paper, we consider the subcritical branching random walk in a random environment. We assume the branching and the step jump are independent; and the branching is in random envirenment, i.e., the particles in generation $n$ produce children according the probability measure $F_n\in \mathcal{P}\left(\N_0\right)$, and the $F_n$, $n=1,2,\cdots, $ are i.i.d under the $P_E$. ``subcritical" means that $ a:=\E[X_1]\in (-\infty,0)$, where $X_1:=\log \overline{F}_1$ and $\overline{F}_1$ is the mean of $F_1$.
